name: live-rider-2c-stop30pct
label: Control (2c Rider + 30% Stop)
desc: Round 1 benchmark: 2c trailing peak stop, 30% adverse drawdown stop, 0.60 entry ceiling, stranded completion enabled.
thesis: Serves as the bridge control from Round 1 with active taker completion to lock in pair merges.
hypothesis: Benchmark against which widened trailing deltas (5c/8c) and tighter stops (15%/20%/25%) are measured.

name: live-rider-5c-stop20pct
label: Rider 5c + 20% Stop
desc: Balanced runner: 5c trailing peak stop gives tennis games breathing room, 20% drawdown stop cuts early losers.
thesis: Wider 5c delta avoids premature noise exits with active taker completion to hedge single legs.
hypothesis: Captures multi-game momentum swings to 70-80c while reducing average loss per loser by 33% vs 30% stop.

name: live-rider-8c-stop25pct
label: Wide Rider 8c + 25% Stop
desc: Full trend runner: 8c trailing peak stop tolerates full set swings, backed by 25% drawdown stop.
thesis: Live tennis momentum shifts in multi-point bursts; an 8c trailing delta stays in the trade with stranded completion backing it.
hypothesis: Highest upside potential on runaway winners, maintaining positive expected value against 25% stopped losers.

name: live-rider-5c-stop15pct
label: Sniper 5c + Tight 15% Stop
desc: Tight defense: cuts losing positions immediately at 15% drawdown (~$0.08 loss), rides winners with 5c delta.
thesis: Aggressive loss truncation: eliminating losers at -15% allows even modest +10% to +20% runner gains to dominate.
hypothesis: Smallest average loss in tournament with 5c upside room, achieving the highest Sharpe/Sortino ratio.

name: live-ud50-r5c-stop20pct
label: Underdog 5c + 20% Stop
profile: naked underdog maker (<=0.50), 5c trailing rider, 20% stop
desc: Underdog value runner: rests lone maker bids <=0.50 (require_two_sided=0), 5c rider, 20% stop, stranded completion enabled.
thesis: Underdogs never suffer favorite collapse traps; riding their comebacks with a 5c delta captures asymmetric upside.
hypothesis: Replicates Round 1 underdog win rate while widening trailing profit target beyond the early 2c exit.

name: live-ud50-r8c-stop25pct
label: Underdog 8c + 25% Stop
profile: naked underdog maker (<=0.50), 8c wide trailing rider, 25% stop
desc: Underdog moonshot: lone underdog maker <=0.50, wide 8c trailing stop for maximum comeback runway, 25% stop.
thesis: When an underdog takes control of a set, they swing from 30c to 80c; an 8c delta absorbs variance to reach the peak.
hypothesis: Generates the largest single-trade profit payouts in the tournament with risk strictly capped at 25%.
